title: 目標達成の後に・春雷を目指して

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer, let's start plannin' our next steps right away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross has found success in a number of graded races and is now ready to progress toward her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Tell it to me straight. My body…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Is it good enough for the big leagues yet? Am I ready for the G1 races?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All RIIIGHT! Startin' today, nobody's lookin' down on me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's payback time, and I'm collectin' with interest. This year, I'm gonna win, win, and win some more!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer. There's this one race I really want to run in. I just have to be there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho! My dad always says…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: Yep, there's no race that better represents the G1 than the spring Tenno Sho. The Derby's nice 'n all, but up against the Tenno Sho? No contest.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: That race's been goin' on for decades. And I've been watchin' it since I was a tyke myself. Never fails to give me chills… I love that race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: The thought of my little Tama runnin' in that race… Why, it almost makes a grown man cry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho means a helluva lot to my dad…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And after everythin' he's done for me, I wanna do right by him. I'll stop at nothin' to enter that race… That okay with you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real?! I owe ya big time! Now I can't wait to call the fam tonight!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I bet Pop's gonna jump for joy when he hears about this! I'm real glad I made it in time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is over the moon. Unfortunately, there's an issue…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? You're gonna get wrinkles with a frown like that.
choice_data_list: The distance could be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The distance? Ya saying 3,200 meters is too much for me?
choice_data_list: I think you have the aptitude for it, but we'll need experience too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pacing and strategy needed for two laps around a course is completely different from what a single lap calls for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to get in at least one more long-distance race before the big event. Which is why…
choice_data_list: We should compete in the G2 Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Daishoten… Isn't that race 3,000 meters? And it's held in Kansai too. My home turf…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A'ight! Let's have us a little homecomin' before the big day. After that, we can hit the road for Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our sights on our first senior-level race, the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: By the way, ya free after this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's a race happenin' this afternoon. A race that just so happens to feature you-know-who.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race in question turns out to be…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Go, go, GOOO! Leave 'em in da dust, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And it's Oguri Cap! Oguri Cap takes the win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This Umamusume may be from the countryside, but her speed's nothing short of explosive! We just got a glimpse of some terrifying talent!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Didja see that, Trainer? There's no stoppin' that girl! She used to be a fish outta water, but now she's got her land legs, and those legs are fast!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: As her more experienced friend, I gotta keep watch over her. If anythin' happens, I'll be needin' your help.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still… That was some performance she put on. I dunno, it's almost like…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Even though she's got a very down-to-earth vibe, there's this flower blooming inside her… When she's racin', ya just can't look away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look over at Oguri Cap, who looks relieved to have won. I have to agree with Tamamo Cross—beyond her strength, something else about her running just… pulls you in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'm not sure how to put that feeling into words… For now, we'll just have to focus on the Hanshin Daishoten.
